title: He Called In Sick for GTA 6. It Went Badly.
description: GTA 6 is out on Thursday 19 November, the first new GTA in thirteen years. Ryan doesn't want to waste annual leave on it, so he builds a business case for calling in sick instead: sick-note rules, GTA flu, a dubious billion-dollar statistic and a game that got delayed twice. Then he makes the call.

seo.title: Called In Sick For GTA 6 And Got Piled With Work
